full_details.title: Modern Chat App UI Overhaul
full_details.full_description:
I’m revamping the interface of an AI-powered chat application. The product already works well, but its current look is plain. I want a polished, modern aesthetic that feels fresh and compelling—definitely not just another ChatGPT.

What I’m after  
• A clean, modern design language across light and dark themes  
• Redesigned chat window, conversation list/side panel, and settings screens  
• Refined typography, spacing, colour palette, component styling and subtle micro-interactions  

Style preferences  
My instinct leans strongly toward a modern feel—nothing overly corporate, but still professional. I don’t have reference links to dictate the direction; I’m happy to see your ideas and explore options together.

Brand alignment  
We do have existing colours and fonts, yet they aren’t set in stone. If keeping a few core elements helps maintain continuity, great; if a fresh approach serves the user experience better, I’m open to that too.

Deliverables  
1. High-fidelity mock-ups (Figma or Sketch) for:  
   – Chat interface (light and dark)  
   – Conversation list / navigation panel  
   – Settings and any auxiliary screens  
2. Component library and style guide defining colours, type scales, spacing and interaction states  
3. Handoff assets ready for engineering: organised layers, design tokens or equivalent, plus motion specs for micro-interactions  

Acceptance criteria  
• Consistent visual system across all screens and modes  
• Clear usability in both desktop and responsive layouts  
• Final files delivered in editable format with all assets grouped and labelled  

If this sounds like your kind of project, let’s create an interface that makes our users feel at home from the very first chat.
